name: Peyrat

text: the print room door lock is jammed n the key snapped off inside, Baulig Vegezzi says use the back way through the archive for now, the locksmith can only come tomorrow afternoon so keep the spare key safe

text: the cricket club nets are booked out solid for the junior sessions n the seniors need monday nights, Amez Hoadrea Ballen checked the school field but the lights are off after eight, can we move the seniors to the indoor cage for two weeks, the coach is fine with it if the cost is covered

name: Izair
text: the smoothie blender at the counter is leaking from the base n the seal looks chewed, Izair says the spare is in the cupboard, can u check the back shelf

name: Dása
text: your dental hygienist appointment is on the 6th at 4:20 at the riverside practice with Dása, arrive ten minutes early and skip coffee beforehand, the parking machine takes cards, the hygienist asked about the sensitivity you mentioned

name: Mastrogiacomo
text: the chimney sweep is booked for the 14th between nine and eleven and he needs the fire cleared out first. Mastrogiacomo says the log basket should move to the garden and the hearth swept once hes done. He will leave the certificate on the mantelpiece. If the weather turns the visit moves to the morning slot

name: Fürpasz Sitar
text: the eye screening is tuesday at 11:15 at the health centre, Fürpasz Sitar said to take the red book and a snack for after, the drops wear off by lunch

name: Ingmar Haltiner Daskin
text: the boiler annual check is on the 18th at nine and the engineer needs the cupboard under the stairs clear. Ingmar Haltiner Daskin checked the flue from the outside last time and says the back gate must be unlocked. The service takes about an hour

name: Viktore
text: the passport interview is at the office on the 9th at 10:40 and they ask for the reference number from the email. Viktore says take the old passport and a second form of id. No bags are allowed in the room so travel light. The nearest car park is behind the library on mill lane

name: Druga
text: the ear wax appointment is monday at 3:40 and Druga said they use the drops for five days before, start tonight so the nurse can finish it in one go

name: Reischl Gros-Gaudenier Rujovic
text: the hearing aid fitting is on the 21st at 2 at the audiology wing and the moulds should be ready. Reischl Gros-Gaudenier Rujovic said to take the old aid so they can transfer the settings. Parking is free for two hours in the hospital lane

name: De Somma
text: the chimney pot survey is booked for wednesday at eight and the roofer needs the drive clear for his van. De Somma says he will work from the front so keep the porch light on and the side gate open. If the wind picks up the visit moves to friday. A written report follows within a week

name: Kaede
text: the cake tasting is saturday at eleven at the bakery, Kaede said to take the deposit receipt and the flavour notes, bring a photo of the table setting

name: Tijssenraad
text: the choir rehearsal moves to the chapel on thursday at 7:30 because the hall has the floor polish. Tijssenraad said to take the new folder with the anthems and a pencil. The organist wants to run the descant twice so dont be late

name: Zejnullah Reithmayer
text: the tyre check is booked for saturday at 9:30 and they rotate the fronts while you wait. Zejnullah Reithmayer says the waiting room has the football on. If the tread is borderline they will quote before any work starts. The book is in the glovebox by the door

name: Rose Valéry
text: the physio check is tuesday at 4 and Rose Valéry asked for the exercises log to be brought in. Wear loose trousers and bring the resistance band

name: Tsutsui
text: the blood pressure review is on the 15th at 3 at the surgery and Tsutsui said the nurse wants two weeks of readings from the home machine. Note them down each morning and bring the cuff so it can be checked.

name: Hannu
text:
the hall floor is being varnished tomorrow so the tables need moving into the side room tonite, i can help after eight when the kids are down, also the stack of chairs by the stage should go up to the loft, whoever is in first can start on those, thanks,
Hannu

name: Erdöközi
text:
the projector remote has gone missing from the cupboard n the talk is tomorrow night, can someone check the committee room drawers, thanks,
Erdöközi

name: Al Jahya
text:
the team shirts have arrived but the sizes are mixed up, i have the order form if anyone wants to swap before saturday, the spare ones go back monday, message me if u need a different size, cheers,
Al Jahya

text:
the fire pits for the bonfire night need stacking by the shed n the wood is still damp from the rain, i moved what i could under the tarpaulin, can someone bring the axe back from the allotment so we can split the dry bits, the marshmallow order came in so that part is sorted, thanks,
Amanuel Ahmadullah Baniavichius

text:

Radu-Gabriel

text:

Crivellin

text:

Aadi Despodov

text:
the spare gazebo poles are in the loft n the fete is saturday, who can grab them on friday, thanks,
Jenö Baumeyer Xayaboun

text:

Aleana

text:

the cake stall takings are in the tin n the float needs banking, can u drop it in monday, thanks,
Piepiorka Al-Farhani

Jongkon Nikolija

text:

Eyaz

Arwed

Gyaltag
